snippet.title: Cards of Prophecy | Demo Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Cards of Prophecy is a deckbuilding tower defense roguelite heavily inspired by TCG. 

Ahead of launch, it's receiving its biggest demo update yet—featuring a completely overhauled UI, brand-new animations, tons of Quality of Life improvements, balance changes, and much more!

Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4273900/Cards_of_Prophecy_Demo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demo_update
